parts.text: What happens to the apparent distance of the image from the mirror?

options.text: The image moves closer to the mirror.
The image moves farther from the mirror.
The image stays on the mirror surface, so its distance from the mirror remains zero.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Sia stands in front of a plane mirror. She steps closer to the mirror, so the object distance decreases.

part_answers.answer: For a plane mirror the image distance equals the object distance, so when Sia moves closer the image also appears closer to the mirror.

teacher.key_rationale: Plane-mirror image distance matches object distance. Moving closer makes the image closer, not farther, and the image is not stuck at zero distance on the surface.
